family.description: This protein family includes the immunity protein YezG from Bacillus subtilis and similar sequences predominantly found in Firmicutes. YezG is the antitoxin component of a LXG toxin-antitoxin (TA) module that promote kin selection, mediate competition in biofilms, and drive spatial segregation of different strains, probably helping to avoid warfare between strains in biofilms [[cite:PUB00101092]]. It shows an alpha/beta structure with an antiparallel beta-sheet.
family.name: Immunity protein YezG-like
